gloss: to be laid up in bed; to fall fast asleep

definitions.gloss: to be laid up in bed; to be bedridden
definitions.explanation: To stay in bed for some time because of illness or injury.

definitions.gloss: to fall fast asleep; to sleep soundly
definitions.explanation: To fall into a deep sleep, often without meaning to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寝込|ねこ}む。
examples.english: To be laid up with a cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧{寝込|ねこ}んだ。
examples.english: My mother was laid up in bed with the flu for three days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧{続|つづ}けた⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧{寝込|ねこ}んでしまった。

⟦{疲|つか}れていた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧{寝込|ねこ}んだ。

examples.english: The burglar broke in late at night, after the family had fallen fast asleep.

notes:
⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (to sleep, to lie down) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (thoroughly). Sense 1 is the commoner one in conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寝込|ねこ}む: to be laid up with a cold
- ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧{寝込|ねこ}む: to run a fever and take to bed
- ⟦ぐっすり→ぐっすり：02676_gussuri⟧{寝込|ねこ}む: to fall fast asleep

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寝|ね}{付|つ}く→寝付く：04646_netsuku⟧: to fall asleep; neutral, the moment of falling asleep
- ⟦{寝|ね}たきり→寝たきり：12323_netakiri⟧: bedridden for good (often of the elderly); {寝込|ねこ}む is temporary
